en-US.description:
See your friends’ shared cities, discover dates when your plans overlap, and keep everyone’s flights together for a shared trip.

FRIENDS, HERE AND NEXT
Browse friends’ latest shared cities and update times. A compact summary highlights friends who recently shared your city; tap to see them. Browse the travel cities and dates your friends have shared with you.

PLAN YOUR NEXT CHANCE TO MEET
Add a destination and your travel dates. New personal plans select all your current accepted, unblocked friends by default. Deselect anyone before saving, or change the audience later. Each plan supports up to 100 friends. Existing plans keep their saved audiences.

Selected friends can browse a plan’s city and dates by default. Turn off browsing to keep it out of Friends’ travel plans while still allowing matches when mutually shared plans overlap. Clear the audience to keep a plan to yourself. Choose reminders for upcoming overlaps.

TRAVEL TOGETHER
Create a shared trip and invite friends. Each person adds and manages their own flights, and members can view available routes, schedules and arrival details together. The map shows airport routes from added flights, not device locations or live aircraft positions. Choose flight-change alerts and manage flight-planning reminders for each trip.

Personal travel plans and shared trips are separate. Joining a trip does not publish a personal plan. Copy a shared trip’s dates into a personal plan, then review its dates and audience before saving.

FRIENDS AT A GLANCE
Add Friends or Here together widgets to your Home Screen or Lock Screen. Feature a preferred friend where supported, and choose whether widgets show names and cities, hide names, or hide all details.

YOUR SHARING CHOICES
Sign in with Apple and connect through accepted friend requests. Pause city sharing globally or for an individual friend, withdraw a pending invitation, or remove and block a friend. Enter a city manually if you prefer not to allow device location access. Find notification controls, appearance choices, privacy details and account deletion in You.

Precise device coordinates are not sent to our servers. The service keeps city-level information and same-city history for its features; flight routes come from flights you add. Pausing city sharing does not change personal-plan audiences or shared-trip membership.

Cities reflect the latest shared update. Background updates, widget refreshes and notifications depend on iOS, permissions and connectivity and are not guaranteed to be immediate. Flight information may be incomplete or outdated; confirm travel arrangements with your airline.
en-US.promotionalText: Share your latest city, find dates when friends’ travel plans overlap, and bring everyone’s flights together for a shared trip.
en-US.whatsNew:
• A cleaner Friends header puts same-city friends beside your city. Expand it when you choose; refreshes and sharing changes no longer open it automatically.
• New personal travel plans select current friends by default, with individual opt-outs before saving.
• Clearer sharing, notification controls, friend invitations and Widget links.
• Better protection for unsaved edits, clearer retry messages, and more reliable offline sharing preferences.
• Improved flight dates and editing, city search, Chinese text, larger text sizes, and light, dark and system appearance.

zh-Hans.description:
看看朋友最近分享的城市，发现旅行日期重叠的机会；一起出发时，把大家的航班安排放在同一次共同旅行里。

朋友的现在与下一站
浏览好友最近分享的城市和更新时间。页头以简洁摘要显示最近与你同城的好友，点击即可展开查看。也可以浏览朋友分享给你的出行城市与日期。

找到下一次相聚的机会
添加目的地和出行日期。新建个人计划默认选中所有当前已接受且未屏蔽的好友，保存前可以取消任何人，之后也能修改分享范围或删除计划。每份计划最多选择100位好友。已有计划保留已保存的分享范围。

选中的好友默认可以浏览计划的城市和日期。关闭好友浏览后，计划不会出现在“好友出行计划”中，但双方分享的计划在同城日期重叠时仍可显示相聚机会。清空好友选择后仅自己可见。你还可以按计划开启重叠提醒。

一起旅行，把安排放在一起
创建共同旅行，邀请朋友加入。每个人添加和管理自己的航班，成员可以一起查看可用的航线、时刻与抵达信息。地图展示所添加航班的机场航线，不展示设备位置或飞机的实时位置。按旅行选择航班变化提醒，并管理航班规划提醒。

个人出行计划与共同旅行分别保存。加入共同旅行不会自动发布个人计划；你可以复制共同旅行的日期，确认自己的日期与分享范围后，再保存为个人计划。

不打开 App，也能看一眼
将好友城市或同城小组件添加到主屏幕和锁屏。在支持的样式中选择关注的好友，并选择显示姓名与城市、隐藏姓名，或隐藏全部详情。

分享范围由你决定
通过 Apple 登录，接受好友请求后建立联系。可以暂停全部或某位好友的城市共享，撤回尚未接受的邀请，以及移除或屏蔽好友。不授权设备定位时，也能手动选择城市。在“你”页面找到通知、外观、隐私说明及删除账号入口。

精确设备坐标不会发送至我们的服务器。服务会保存城市级信息及功能所需的同城历史；航线来自你添加的航班。暂停城市共享不会改变个人计划的分享范围或共同旅行的成员关系。

城市信息以最近共享的更新为准。后台更新、小组件刷新与通知受 iOS、权限及网络条件影响，不保证即时更新。航班信息可能不完整或已过期，请以航空公司信息确认出行安排。
zh-Hans.promotionalText: 看看朋友最近分享的城市和下一站，找到出行日期重叠的机会；一起出发时，把大家的航班安排放在同一次共同旅行里。
zh-Hans.whatsNew:
• 同城好友融入首页，手动点击才展开，刷新或切换共享状态不会自动展开。
• 新建个人出行计划默认选中当前好友，保存前可逐一取消。
• 城市共享、通知设置与好友邀请更清楚，小组件链接更准确。
• 改善未保存修改的保护、失败重试提示和离线共享设置的可靠性。
• 修复航班日期与编辑问题，完善城市搜索、中文、大字号以及浅色、深色和跟随系统外观。

reviewNotes:
Across Us uses Sign in with Apple. Reviewers can create an account with their own Apple Account; there is no shared username/password. Location and notification permissions are optional. This build uses the production service with local demo mode disabled.

Review paths:
1. Sign in, then open You > City sharing. Select a city manually without granting location access, or use Apple location and geocoding services. Friends see a city and its last update. Precise device coordinates are not sent to our servers. Automatic background updates require the relevant iOS permission and remain subject to system scheduling.
2. For two-person features, sign in on two devices with different Apple Accounts. Add each other by username from Friends and accept the request. Pending sent invitations can be withdrawn. Empty friend lists remain navigable.
3. You > My travel plans creates a personal city/date plan. New plans select all current accepted, unblocked friends; deselect anyone before saving. Maximum audience: 100. Clear the audience for an owner-only plan. Existing plans keep their saved audiences; adding a friend does not expand old plans.
4. Selected friends can browse a plan by default. “Show in friends’ travel plans” controls full-plan browsing, separately from overlap matching with selected friends who also share eligible plans. Turning browsing off does not disable matching. Overlap reminders are separate and default off. Friends’ travel plans is reached from Friends, and overlaps appear in Together soon.
5. Shared trips is a separate tab. Create a trip, invite a friend, and add your own flight number and departure date. Members manage their own flights. Route maps show airport routes from verified flights, not device locations or live aircraft positions. Lookup may return no results; saving an unverified number does not invent a route or schedule. Copying trip dates to a personal plan creates an independent draft, and joining a trip does not publish a personal plan.
6. You > Notifications provides the notification overview and controls. Flight-change alerts default off. Flight-planning reminders can be disabled per trip. Background updates, flight checks and push delivery are not guaranteed to be immediate.
7. Add Friends, near and far or Here together widgets through iOS. Home Screen and rectangular/circular Lock Screen styles are supported. You > Widget & Lock Screen controls privacy. Preferred-friend selection is available where supported on Friends widgets.
8. You > Privacy & data explains stored data. You > Delete account removes the authentication account, account-linked personal plans, friendships, city-sharing records and notification devices, then clears local account caches. Participant names and previously added flights may remain in shared trips for other members; the confirmation explains this and advises removing your flights first if you do not want them retained.

City sharing and personal-plan/trip sharing have separate controls. Stored data also includes same-city events/stay periods, flight lookup requests and bounded operational diagnostics described in the public privacy policy. No address-book import, advertising or cross-app tracking is included.

Version 1.0.6 updates same-city presentation, plan audiences, sharing/invitation/notification controls, Widget navigation, unsaved-edit protection, flight dates/editing, Chinese localization and accessibility. It does not provide in-app chat or a Say hello message-sending feature.

whatToTest.en-US: Build 28: Check the compact same-city header stays collapsed until you tap it. Test new-plan audiences and opting out, unsaved-edit protection, invitation error/retry, offline sharing preferences, notification controls, flight dates and verified-flight editing, and Widget friend links. Try English/Chinese, dark mode and large text. City updates and notifications depend on iOS and connectivity. Use disposable accounts for any deletion test.
whatToTest.zh-Hans: 构建28：检查同城页头只有手动点击才展开。测试新计划默认好友范围与取消选择、未保存修改保护、邀请失败与重试、离线共享设置、通知控制、航班日期及已验证航班编辑、小组件好友跳转。请同时体验中英文、深色和大字号。城市更新与通知受系统和网络影响；删除账号测试仅使用可丢弃的测试账号。
